claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. The union only covers spell, class_feature, and mastery. Magic items require their own top-level record kind with distinct mechanics families (passive item properties, activated item charges, etc.).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Weapon (Dagger), Rare — this is a magic item, not a spell, class feature, or mastery.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: dawn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The dagger's poison coating resets at next dawn, which is not covered by short_rest, long_rest, short_or_long_rest, or partial_short_full_long.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The weapon can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: poisoned
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The save gate on-fail result applies the Poisoned condition, but the Condition type currently only supports 'prone'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DcSource: fixed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The poison save uses a fixed DC 15 — not caster_spell_save_dc (no caster) and not weapon_attack_dc (which is 8 + ability mod + PB). A fixed numeric DC is a distinct variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.
